glyph_origin: Phono-semantic compound (形聲): semantic 艸 (“grass”) + phonetic 屯 (“swollen sprout”) + semantic 日 (“sun”). Some oracle-bone and bronze forms contain only two components, either 艸/屮/木 with 屯, or 日 with 屯. The character may relate to a semantic cluster of its phonetic series: 蠢 (“to stir”), 純 (“pure, unmixed”), 敦 (“round”), and 芚 (“to sprout”). The form 萅 preserves the older arrangement with 艸. In the regular script, the 艸 and 屯 have merged into 𡗗.
